name: MPI Defocus Rendering
definition: A rendering algorithm for synthetic defocus, including lateral camera translation, applied to a Multi-Plane Image (MPI) representation. The MPI consists of planes with colors in linear HDR space, sampled linearly in disparity within a camera frustum at a central camera pose.
summary: MPI Defocus Rendering synthesizes images with realistic depth-of-field blur and lateral camera translation by compositing a precomputed Multi-Plane Image using efficient 2D convolutions rather than continuous volumetric ray casting.
